name: doctor-tracker
description: Doctor Tracker — Next.js client + Express/MongoDB API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
